328707c.summary: Builds a list of environmental effect card scripts for an army, choosing offensive or defensive cards and limiting by draft victories or owned rewards.

3287138.summary: Removes and returns the top card of the player's or enemy's shuffled deck for a mulligan, activating its GameObject and logging if the deck is empty.

32872b8.summary: Builds a localized battle-result share message with the opponent name and requests Android storage permission to share a screenshot.

3283eac.summary: Handles a hero dying: logs state, ends the battle, builds the ranked match result with skulls and duration, then saves the winner and finishes the battle.

32876dc.summary: Logs and records the current match result's winner if the battle is in post-battle stage, then processes the match result unless already recorded.

3287b14.summary: Submits the finished match result to the server or live ops handler, retrying via SaveMatchWinner and logging an error if winner state mismatches.

32881c0.summary: Stores the online match result, marks processing finished, updates missions, achievements and alliance trophies, then shows the finish screen.

3288370.summary: Gathers match data such as winner, health, turn count and deck names and sends it to the analytics service.

3288744.summary: Closes any open voice-line popup, resets connection status to connected, and disables the active skill description object.

328041c.summary: Subscribes the voice line popup show and hide handlers to the voice lines controller events.

32830f0.summary: Unsubscribes the voice line popup show and hide handlers from the voice lines controller events.

32887b0.summary: Marks a popup as open and plays the chat-show sound cue through the SoundManager, with debug logging.

328756c.summary: Determines the battle winner after battle end, returning draw if the hero is dead or draw was pressed, and forcing player win in always-win tutorial stages.

3288830.summary: Finishes an offline battle, setting rewards on a win and advancing the campaign index, then marks the result as saved.

3285594.summary: Logs an error and cancels the match without a result, setting disconnected status and notifying the player data manager and desync listeners.

3288b04.summary: Cancels the match: leaves the battle room when not won, or on a win resigns, ends the battle and records the result.

3284700.summary: Logs an error and cancels the match with a victory for the player after a desync, notifying the server and opponent unless already finished.

3285d7c.summary: Builds a formatted game-state string containing warlord, in-play, hand and deck data for both players.

3288bf0.summary: Builds a debug string describing a hero's id, health, melee and ranged attack and whether it can attack.

3288f38.summary: Builds a debug string listing every in-play unit for a side with index, id, health, attacks and can-attack flag.

3289734.summary: Builds a debug string listing the id and unique id of every card in a side's deck.

328570c.summary: Creates a resign player action, flags suspicious games, and appends the action to the current turn's player or enemy action log.

3289db0.summary: Returns true if the player has no skulls and the game time is below the suspicious-game threshold.

3289e54.summary: Deactivates all cards in the cemetery and the hidden cards remaining in both shuffled decks.

32877f8.summary: Finishes the battle, triggers victory chat, and either runs post-battle scripted actions or starts the basic battle end sequence.

328a430.summary: Returns the match player id for the current player or the opponent id depending on whose turn it is.

328a4ec.summary: Computes how much unused mana can be saved from the mana accumulation setting and records it on the player's mana manager.

328a580.summary: Handles drawing cards at turn start, skipping draw if a sentinel is present and playing sentinel effects or queuing overtime draw actions.

328a6c8.summary: Activates the minions and hero for the side whose turn begins, updating canAct and canAttack state and attack animation indicators.

328a844.summary: Handles the end-turn button click, rejecting it when blocked or pending berzerk attacks exist, otherwise stopping the clock and queuing an end turn action.

328b8dc.summary: Queues an automatic end-turn action for the given player with the turn-end priority.
